record.body:
## Problem

Dashboard `d` clears Needs-you gates in one keypress without showing evidence, confirming, recording a rationale, or guarding the displayed revision.

## Approach

Decisions: dashboard-approvals-scope (full #8), approval-revision-guard (displayed revision, not `@current`). Structured work: specification and design `dashboard-approvals`.

Require detail + confirm with notes; Approve/Reject for plan review; Sign and Accept risk with recorded rationale; supersede stale read-only constraints; contract optional note fields; tests and README. Independent of retry/reviewer/tiered-verification feature work.

## Exit criteria

- `d` from list opens detail; no write without detail + confirm (tests).
- Plan-review Approve/Reject, manual sign, and finding accept-risk record notes as specified; Reject keeps the block and routes back.
- Writes use displayed revision; stale revision shows a message and skips the write.
- Stale `dashboard-read-only*` constraints superseded; README keys updated; skill↔contract consistency green when applicable.
record.subject: dashboard-approvals
